text:
Rina: quick thread — post-release triage. Two signals: 1) a performance regression for multi-turn chat under 6k+ context, 2) a list of 8 small UX asks from pilot customers. want opinions: do a single rapid squad or split bug-first + async polish?

Omar: need numbers first. regression severity?

Rina: p95 latency for multi-turn went from ~180ms -> ~360ms for 6k token sessions; error rate small but visible retries. pilot feedback: login onboarding wording, copy tweaks, a reorder in the settings page, and one accessibility label.

Becca: bugs-first. infra teams hate context switches when debugging perf. can we scope polish to owners doing async PRs?

Nate: agree with Becca. Also, estimate for polish: ~2 dev-days if done by part-timers. Perf fix: profiling -> 3 dev-days plus canary. ops support needed.

sys-bot: Canary reservation created: canary-res-556, 3 GPU nodes, window 6h.

Rina: trade-off question from PM: some pilot customers explicitly asked for copy and flow fixes before they expand. if we delay polish, risk slower adoption. how many are blocking?

Becca: only one customer is blocking expansion on UX grounds; others called them "nice-to-have." we can communicate a plan and keep them in the loop.

Omar: proposal: 5-day micro-sprint, with clear priorities. Day 0: triage + owners. Day 1-3: perf squad works full-time (Omar lead). Day 2-4: polish owners work asynchronously, target low-effort items only. Day 5: roll + follow-up comms. Freeze: no non-critical serving runtime merges for the week.

Rina: acceptance criteria for perf: p95 <=220ms for 6k token multi-turn under staging harness and retries <0.3%. For polish: complete 6/8 low-effort items and publish updated onboarding docs.

Nate: can we parallelize by having two small squads? perf-squad (Omar + 2 runtime engs), polish-surge (Becca + 2 part-timers). Ops to handle canary and monitoring. I can coordinate QA windows.

Becca: I'll make a short PR template and tag polish PRs with label:postlaunch-polish to keep reviews fast. Also will push the critical copy change first (customer blocker).

Omar: perf plan (pinned):
```
1. reproduce regression on perf-cluster with 6k multi-turn scenario
2. capture traces + CPU/kvcache stats
3. try two experiments: a) tighter batching policy b) async kvcache flush tuning
4. deploy experiment 1 to canary (5% traffic) for 1h, collect p95
5. if p95 improves, expand to 20% then full roll
```

sys-bot: Canary created: canary-mt-1819. Alerts: #eng-oncall.

Rina: communications plan: notify pilot customers we are shipping a targeted perf mitigation this week and will follow with UX fixes next week. keep message short and set expectations.

Nate: QA plan: two 1-hour windows during canary (start + mid-run) and a 30-minute smoke after roll. I'll post schedule.

Becca: for backlog hygiene, moving remaining polish items into a "post-polish" milestone with owners and estimates so they don't vanish.

Omar: decision: freeze serving merges except hotfixes, spin up two squads as proposed. I'll lead perf; Becca leads polish. Rina will update roadmap and notify sales/support.

Rina: noted. I'll also add a rollback plan: revert to previous runtime build if p95 worsens or retries spike >0.5% during canary. Postmortem trigger if customer-impacting failures persist >6h.

Becca: will post the PR checklist in ~30m.

Nate: allocating QA slots now. check-in tomorrow 9:00. :thumbsup:

Omar: starting triage now. will post findings in #eng-runtime. :rocket:
